name: l2cap_work_submit
prototype: int l2cap_work_submit(void *owner, void *handler, void *done, void *arg, char flag)

ownership.argument: Astrolink binds this as the work-list entry the public LE CoC wrappers use. Queue head and lock are separate globals on this build, not fields of the owner.

provenance.source: Allocates a 20-byte node with 0xC7EADD4 and inserts it under the lock dword_2013BD7C into the queue dword_2013BD74 through 0xC7EAE34; node fields are owner +0, arg +4, handler +8, done +12, flag byte +16. This is the single public entry every bt_l2cap_* wrapper uses (80 call sites); the owner-only intrusive half is 0xC7EAE34.

notes: Astrolink binds this as the work-list entry the public LE CoC wrappers use. Queue head and lock are separate globals on this build, not fields of the owner.
